content.short: MugglePay is a crypto payment solution for merchants accepting TON, stablecoins, and many other assets.
content.description: MugglePay helps businesses accept crypto payments through payment links, plugins, and merchant integrations. Its site describes support for USDT and USDC across chains including TON, plus WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, WHMCS, and other business workflows. The listing is relevant as payment infrastructure for merchants rather than a TON-native wallet. MugglePay is a crypto payment solution that accepts USDT/USDC on Celo, Arbitrum, Ton, ICP, Stellar, Polygon, Base, Solana, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Tron in just 5 minutes.
